briefing.headline: OpenAI and DeepSeek push frontier capabilities as DialectForge secures multi-agent protocols

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced multimodal systems. Investment remains robust while safety vulnerabilities persist across production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI launched o4-pro with enhanced reasoning; DeepSeek-V4 closed the gap on coding benchmarks; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus debuted with improved agentic workflows while Meta open-sourced Llama 4 Scout.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp continues with TSMC securing additional 3nm capacity; Microsoft and xAI announced joint 200k H100-equivalent cluster in Texas.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks in the US and EU meaningfully constrain open-weight frontier model releases before 2027?
